coverage: All 22 prepared conversations completed under runner v0.2.0: six development and sixteen provisional pilot examples. The run produced 100 representation-specific QA outputs, covering 300 scored answers across the 66 unique probes. No pilot examples were dropped after observing outcomes.
findings: The tracker does not outperform the ordinary generated summary on the real pilot: it is one question lower (21/24 versus 22/24). The question-only control achieves 17/24, showing that high scores can be obtained without the conversation. This makes high absolute accuracy weak evidence of faithful commitment tracking. The comparison is descriptive, with only eight real pilot conversations.

Synthetic pilot scores are: transcript 24/24, generated summary 24/24, tracker 24/24, question-only control 10/24. These short, clean, assistant-authored cases test specific update behaviors but do not establish robustness on natural dialogue.

Error inspection shows a tradeoff. In mb_29, the tracker preserves the approval prerequisite for making funds available, which the generated summary loses. In mb_17, the tracker omits a return date and a promise to resume public comment after a technical fix, both retained by the summary. Both representations omit the chair's future signing action in mb_08. Against the draft keys, the tracker gains one real-pilot answer over the summary, loses two, and ties on 21.

A development-case audit also reveals a measurement gap: mb_00 receives 3/3 tracker QA accuracy even though its record labels an authorization as an unqualified active undertaking and cites a vote from the preceding agenda item. The exact quote is present, but its attachment is wrong. This motivates evaluating full records and semantic evidence support separately; these illustrative audits are not a measured unsupported-record rate.
runtime: The analyzed run contains 176 unique inference calls, 113,442 input tokens, and 26,170 generated tokens. Summed model-generation time is 68.9 minutes, excluding model download/setup and other overhead; peak allocated GPU memory is 18.37 GiB. Across 53 tracker chunks, 2 update attempts were rejected and 1 chunk remained invalid after repair. There were 0 malformed/missing QA answers and 0 calls that reached the output-token cap. Per-condition costs and every raw response are saved; the methods are not compute-matched.
